summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs launched Muse Image and previewed Muse Video, its first media generation models, featuring agentic tool use, self-refinement, and test-time compute scaling for image and video generation.

mechanisms.reason: The model is designed to spend more inference-time compute (reasoning tokens, tool calls, self-refinement steps) per generated image, increasing compute consumed per output.
mechanisms.quote: With more test-time compute, the model reasons more, uses more tool calls, and uses more self-refinement steps to improve its generations.

mechanisms.reason: The launch introduces a new class of agentic image generation that invokes tools, self-refines, and scales with test-time compute rather than simple prompt-to-image mapping.
mechanisms.quote: Instead of directly mapping prompts to images, Muse Image operates as an agent: it invokes search and coding tools to improve accuracy, self-refines its own generations, and improves through scaling test-time compute.

practices.reason: A new image/video generation model with agentic tool use and test-time reasoning changes what could be built for image-generation workflows, but gains are reported via the lab's own internal ablations and Arena rankings.
practices.quote: Muse Image is our most advanced image generation model yet: it follows instructions faithfully, edits with precision, and composes from multiple references.

practices.reason: The described pattern of combining search/coding tool calls with self-refinement loops inside chain-of-thought is a concrete agentic design with stated win-rate gains, though it is internal to Meta's RL-trained model rather than an externally reusable recipe.
practices.quote: We provide Muse Image with access to tools to enhance its agentic capabilities.

practices.reason: Win-rate and Elo ablations are used to justify design choices like tool use and test-time scaling, but the methodology is internal and not directly transferable to another team's stack.
practices.quote: Muse Image improves with search tool use. Win rate from internal ablation.

notable_reason: Meta's first agentic media-generation model family with test-time compute scaling for image and video is a distinct architectural approach worth tracking, even though the mechanism evidence is largely internal.
